items.title: Customer Data Cleaning & Standardization
items.shortDescription: Cleaned and standardized a sample customer workbook of about 5,250 records.
items.description: A portfolio exercise based on a messy customer workbook covering duplicate removal, capitalization, phone/email/date standardization, missing-data checks and a final quality summary.
items.disclosure: This is an independent portfolio project built on a sample dataset. It is not client work.
items.problem: The raw workbook contained repeated records, inconsistent text and phone formats, mixed date formats, invalid emails and missing information.
items.objective: Turn the raw workbook into one consistent dataset that is easier to filter, summarize and reuse, while clearly identifying problem records.
